reason: Nothing is on fire this week, and I only switch software when board exams or the new session force my hand. Even the Rs 30,000 launch price plus GST goes over my Rs 25,000 limit, so it means a meeting with the trust chairman for 14 modules when we really use fees and attendance.
objection: A new company I have never heard of wants to hold our fee records and parent data. If it fails in the middle of the session, I am the one who answers to the chairman and the parents.
would_change_my_mind: A principal from another CBSE school nearby showing me it worked through their board exams, and a fees plus attendance bundle under Rs 25,000 that I can sign for myself before the session starts.
